title: Angular Momenta in $4+1$ Vacuum Critical Collapse
summary: We investigate the critical collapse of gravitational waves that carry angular momenta. Working in five-dimensional vacuum Einstein gravity under an SU$(2)\times\mathbb Z_4$ symmetry ansatz, we numerically evolve several families of initial data near the threshold of black-hole formation. Near-critical data approaches the discretely self-similar Bizoń-Chmaj-Schmidt solution, which is irrotational.
